$comment: Known, accepted deviations between src/api and the official spec. Only findings NOT listed here fail `npm run spec:impact`; this list should shrink over time. Most entries are attributes our code declares that the official schemas never documented. Verified against the live sandbox org on 2026-08-20: of 26 such attributes only 3 are actually returned (custom_field.description, line_item.description, service.description) -- the rest, including person.is_active and deal.budget_type, do not exist in API responses. ignoreNewEndpoints: /api/v2/boards is documented but 404s on our tenant -- we use /api/v2/folders.
